scope: actual PHP-rendered production JavaScript; simulated DOM/fetch/timers only; no live requests

cases.case: slow status fetch never overlaps another status or detail request; polling begins after completion
20/40 second aborts and 30/60 second cooldowns grow, then success restores ten second polling
seven failures keep retrying at 300 second intervals and eventually recover
429 Retry-After seconds larger than the normal backoff are respected
hidden pages pause requests and showing the page preserves the remaining cooldown
showing a page after its cooldown initiates only one overdue read
detail pagination shares the read guard and appends only the original snapshot
stale detail responses cannot append cards or overwrite a newer cursor
a detail outage preserves existing cards and cursor while entering recovery
an ambiguous POST is sent once; subsequent automatic recovery sends only status GETs
manual POST cancels and finishes an active read before sending; cancellation is not a failed connection
401 waits for corrective action instead of repeatedly submitting unchanged credentials
HTTP 200 login HTML is an invalid response, never a healthy monitor
session storage errors do not break rendering or recovery
reopening the page retains the failure count and remaining cooldown
very long Retry-After is split into timer chunks without a premature network retry
the total timeout includes response-body decoding; late success cannot replace unverified state
